## Boundaries

- `src/collect.ts` converts handled logs and uncaught exceptions into one error record.
- `src/schema.ts` owns the Analytics Engine column layout and queries.
- `scripts/errors.mts` queries grouped errors through the Analytics Engine SQL API.
- Do not store request headers, query strings, or unredacted URLs.
